ios.desc:
Surf reports in real time by checking nearby marine weather buoys, now with tide charts and tide times. Avoid relying on inaccurate forecasts.

Wave reports & buoy readings made easy for surfing (wave sizes, swell direction and period, wind speed/direction and more), plus the tide table for your spot.

Know in advance if the surf is good.
Too often swell arrives later than predicted. By checking the buoy wave data, you can see if the swell has arrived, and the tide times tell you when to paddle out. If not, go back to bed =)

▶ 620+ NOAA & worldwide buoys, now in more places: North America, Europe, South America, Africa, Asia and Oceania.
▶ Tides! Tide charts, tide times and tide tables with forecasts up to 7 days ahead for 4,380+ stations worldwide.
▶ Map of every buoy and tide station, with search.
▶ Home and Lock Screen widgets for buoys and tides. (Pro)
▶ Wave size notifications to score the best surf. (Pro)
▶ Favorite buoys and tide stations. (Pro)
▶ Apple Watch app with buoys, tides and complications.
▶ iPad version.
▶ Historical charts.
▶ Dark and Light mode support.

▶ HOW IT WORKS
Set your nearest or preferred buoy and tide station as your main ones and you are ready to get real-time buoy updates, 24-hour charts, the tide forecast, buoy alerts (Pro) and much more.

Tide now shows the current water level and whether it's rising or falling. Drag along the tide chart to check the level at any time of the day, and swipe through the next days to plan your sessions.

Add widgets to your Home Screen and Lock Screen (Pro) to check the buoy and the tide at a glance, and set Apple Watch complications to see buoy and tide data on your wrist.

If offline, the latest buoy observations stay available for your main buoy, and many tide predictions work without a connection.

Buoy readings include swell size, direction and period. Some buoys provide weather information, such as wind direction, wind speed, air and water temperature.

Please check that there are wave buoys or tide stations in your area before purchasing.
